changelog.1.2.2: The SDK article renderer no longer deletes the status line, so reloading the documentation works and the load result stays visible.
changelog.1.2.1: The footer is hidden outside the Build tab instead of staying as an empty bar, and the SDK tab logs whether the repository document loaded.
changelog.1.2.0: Full Korean/English translation with an in-app Settings tab (language, theme, notification test), live language switching, OS notification when a package is built, fixed result card disappearing after visiting the SDK tab.
changelog.1.1.0: Guided 3-step build flow with a live readiness checklist, SDK/API reference downloaded from the repository, launcher language/theme and a responsive layout.
changelog.1.0.0: Initial release: manifest editor, file bundling, SHA-256 and download.
